What would you like to know about?

Mystery Gift allows you to receive great gifts
through various communication modes.
Once you have received a gift,
please go to any Pokémon Center and
pick it up from the delivery girl.

When you’ve received a Mystery Gift,
your Wonder Card will be displayed
in the Card Album.
When you’ve picked up the gift from a
delivery girl, the card will have a stamp on it.
Make sure to pick up gifts
when the cards aren’t stamped.
There is a limit to how many
cards you can save in the Album.
You can store up to 24 cards.
When the card slots are full, you will
not be able to receive any more.
Please delete some from the Album.

When you cannot receive new cards,
please check the Card Album.
If it’s full with 24 Wonder Cards, choose a
Wonder Card from a gift you’ve already picked
up and press the A Button to throw it away.
If you have gifts waiting, go to any Pokémon
Center and pick them up from the delivery girl.
